credentials.description: clientId (API key), provided in the Djomy merchant space
clientSecret (secret key), provided in the Djomy merchant space

parameters.name: transactionReference
parameters.description: The transactionId returned by create_payment. Passed as a path parameter.

example_prompt: Add OTP confirmation to my Djomy payment flow.

oneTimePin.description: The OTP code sent by the mobile operator (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, etc.) to the payer. Djomy's pattern: \d{4,6}.

response_schema.description: Same response structure as verify_payment. Wrapped in { success, message, data, error, timestamp, status }.

status.description: SUCCESS: the payment succeeded. PENDING: the payer is being asked by the operator to validate. CREATED, REDIRECTED, FAILED, CANCELLED as in verify_payment.

paymentLinkReference.description: Payment link reference, only when the payment was made through a payment link.

gotchas: This capability is only used for the direct payment flow (create_payment). Do NOT call it after create_payment_gateway — that flow handles OTP on the Djomy portal itself.
The OTP is sent by the mobile operator (Orange Money, MTN MoMo) to the payer's phone. Djomy does not send the OTP — you must collect it from the payer in your UI.
The path parameter is called transactionReference in the URL but corresponds to the transactionId returned by create_payment. They refer to the same value.
Even after a successful OTP confirmation, call verify_payment to confirm status === 'SUCCESS' before fulfilling the order.
HTTP 403 "Accès non autorisé à cette transaction" when the transaction does not belong to your account.
Only the X-API-KEY header is documented for this endpoint (no Bearer token, unlike create_payment and verify_payment).
open_questions: Production base URL: Djomy's API reference lists only https://sandbox-api.djomy.africa ("Staging environment"). Ask the user or Djomy for the production URL — never guess it.
Is a retried confirmOTP call safe? Djomy's API reference (openapi-partner.json) documents no idempotency header or behaviour for POST /v1/payments/{transactionReference}/confirmOTP.
